name: service_meta_label
label: Service Meta Label (SD4)
help_text: Prefix label for the service meta block shown BELOW the referred-by info when the shareable URL carries ?service=<hubdb_row_id>. Blank when no service param is present.

name: form_heading
label: Form Heading
help_text: Heading shown above the form card.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: form_subtext
label: Form Sub-text
help_text: Small text shown below the heading, above the referred-by block.

name: referred_by_label
label: Referred By Label
help_text: Label shown above the referrer's name in the form card. Referrer details come from URL parameters.

name: form
label: Registration Form
help_text: Select the 'Refer Landing Signup' form. Create it first in HubSpot Marketing > Forms.

default.message: Thanks for joining! Check your email to confirm your account.

name: disclaimer_text
label: Disclaimer Text
help_text: Small text shown below the submit button.
default: Your details are never shared or sold. Unsubscribe at any time.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
